[[:File:Bear's Sloth ingame.jpg|View weapon's in-game proportions]] | attribute = [[Hammer Mastery]] | damagetype = [[Blunt damage]] | unique = yes | icon = Bear's Sloth }} [[Decade Hammer "Bear's Roar"]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[hammer]] obtained from [[Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith]] in [[Embark Beach]] during the [[Anniversary Celebration]] in exchange for 5 [[Proof of Legend|Proofs of Legend]]. ==Stats== :[[Blunt damage|Blunt Dmg]]: 19-35 (Requires 9 [[Hammer Mastery]]) :Deals 20% additional [[damage]] during [[Special event|Festival events]]. No effect in [[PvP]]. :Double adrenaline gain (Chance: 10%) :[[Leadership]]: 5 (if your rank is lower. No effect in PvP.) :{{Gray|Two-handed}} :Crafted in tribute to an enduring legend. ==Skin== Uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Bear's Sloth]] . ==Replica== This item cannot be replicated, as the "+20% damage during Festival Events" mod does not exist outside the unique Decade weapons. ==Notes== *The inherent bonus damage during events is only active during certain events ([[Canthan New Year]], [[Anniversary Celebration]], [[Dragon Festival]], [[Wayfarer's Reverie]], [[Halloween]], and [[Wintersday]]). * Without attribute points invested in Leadership, the inherent Leadership from this weapon provides 2 Energy if you use a [[shout]] or [[chant]] that affects one or more [[ally|allies]]. {{anomaly|Unlike [[Decade Rod "All the World"]], [[Decade Rod "Antipode Alloy"]], [[Decade Rod "Undying Service"]], [[Decade Staff "Astral Pillar"]], [[Decade Staff "Underworld Pillar"]] and all non-Decade [[weapon]]s, this hammer's appearance is not changed when the wielder is under the effects of a [[weapon spell]].}} ==Trivia== *Introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20250415|April 15, 2025 update]]. {{Decade weapons nav}} [[Category:Decade weapons|Hammer]] [[Category:Hammer Mastery unique items]] [[Category:Unreplicable unique items]]
